sloka: दिष्ट्या तस्य महाबाहो कालस्येवाभिधावतः ।मुक्तः सुररिपोर्वीर प्राप्तश्च विजयस्त्वया ।। ७.१.२९ ॥
transliteration: diṣṭyā tasya mahābāho kālasyevābhidhāvataḥ ।muktaḥ surariporvīra prāptaśca vijayastvayā ।। 7.1.29 ॥

translations.english: O mighty-armed hero, fortunately, you have been freed from that enemy of the gods who was rushing like death itself, and victory has been achieved by you.
